For I have seen in Wurzburg a canon of the cathedral of Saint Burkhart, named Herr Jacob Leimbecher, who was fat and very large of body, made lean through this electuary, and he abstained from roasted meat for a long time. But as soon as he began eating roasted food again, he became fat and large again. Although this goes against the rules one would prescribe in phthisis or hectic fever, where the wasting patients prefer broth and boiled meat as bringing more natural moisture.
